{{Quote|I'm not a terrorist. I'm a patriot. And resistance is not terrorism.|Saw Gerrera|<ref name="The Soft War">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref>}}
'''Saw Gerrera''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Onderon rebels/Legends|rebel]] who served in the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|rebellion]] to take control of the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] from its [[King/Legends|king]] who had sided with the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==

===Early Life===
Saw Gerrera was a young<ref name=":1" /> male [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="WoTF" /> native from [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]],<ref name=":1" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and lived during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> He had a sister named [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]]<ref name="WoTF" /> and they lived originally at [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].<ref name=":1" /> His sister Steela knew him the most and could easily cut through his bluster with a well-timed and affectionate jibe.<ref name=":0">{{SWE|1=characters|2=steelagerrera|3=Steela Gerrera}}</ref>

Saw Gerrera was a loyal follower of King [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]], the benevolent monarch of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. He believed firmly in independence, and did not want to see his planet thrust into galactic warfare<ref name=":1">{{SWE|characters|sawgerrera|Saw Gerrera}}</ref>

===Fighting for Onderon===
====Early fights against Rash====
[[File:Saw_gerrera_detail.png|thumb|left|339x339px|Saw Gerrera, a man who fought for the liberation of his planet.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> at the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] took control of Onderon<ref name="WoTF" /> after a local coup<ref name="A War on Two Fronts Date">{{FactFile2014|44|20 BBY 43-46|Liberation of Onderon}}</ref> that saw [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] taking the throne as the new king.<ref name="WoTF" /> The [[Onderonian/Legends|people]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], though, began to reject Rash's rule,<ref name=":4">{{SWE|characters|general-tandin|General Tandin}}</ref> as they preferred the neutral stance championed by former monarch [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]].<ref name=":5">{{SWE|locations|onderon|Onderon}}</ref>

Saw was one of the fervent young loyalists who refused to acknowledge Rash's rule,<ref name=":1" /> and openly rebelled against the crown.<ref name="WoTF" /> He and his sister Steela were cast out of the walled city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] and forced to live in ruins amid the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. There, Saw plotted against Rash's draconian rule.<ref name=":1" />

Saw Gerrera, [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]], [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]], and others formed a movement to take back control of the system,<ref name="WoTF" /> which included patriots<ref name="SWE-dalgo">{{SWE|characters|dalgo|dalgo}}</ref> and outcasts.<ref name="SWE-Onderon rebels">{{SWE|groups|onderonrebels|Onderon rebels}}</ref> Nobody was appointed leader so Saw took it upon himself to be the unofficial leader of the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderonian rebellion]]. He led those who opposed the government deep into the jungles of the planet and established a base of operations in the middle of old Onderon ruins.<ref name="WoTF" /> Saw looked down his nose at Lux Bonteri, the planet's nominal [[Senator/Legends|Senatorial]] representative. He believed words and politics have done Onderon little favor, and questioned Lux's effectiveness in the rebellion.<ref name=":1" />

====Help from the Republic====
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="A War on Two Fronts Date" /> Gerrera and [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Bonteri]] sent for help from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] who in turn sent [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] to help train the rebels. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived, the rebels were trained in ways of how to disarm [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]] and how to properly take out [[Droideka/Legends|Droidekas]]. When the people had to divide into groups to train on taking out Droidekas, Tano was asked by Saw to help him practice throwing droid poppers.<ref name="WoTF" /> Saw was impressed with what he saw in the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], in her combat skills and perhaps more.<ref name=":1" />

While the rebels were testing their shooting abilities, a group of droids attacked the rebel's base, which escalated into a firefight. Gerrera and the other rebels held their own until an AAT was brought in. Gerrera and Bonteri, who failed to disarm the AAT during practice, tried again and succeeded. Following a successful defense of their position, [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] proposed a plan that the Rebel forces hide in the middle of the capital of Onderon [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. That way they could blend into the masses and be hard to find. Saw agreed with Bonteri's plan.<ref name="WoTF" />

Later, Gererra accompanied Bonteri, Steela, Tano, Kenobi, Skywalker, and Rex into the capital city where they split up to find supplies and reinforcements. The rebels started hit-and-run attacks on the droid army. The next step was to win the people's support. The rebel figured destroy the city power generator would deprive the droids of a recharge station. Following this, Kenobi, Skywalker and Rex returned to Coruscant while Tano remained as an advisor.<ref name=":2">{{TCW|Front Runners}}</ref>
[[File:Saw_reckless_in_Iziz_Onderon.jpg|thumb|250x250px|Saw shoots at some battle droids in [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].]]
While performing reconnaissance of the generator, Saw tore off a battle droid's head to gain information. Determining that the defenses were too heavily fortified for a direct assault, the rebels decided to hijack an AAT. To do that, they ambush a droid patrol so they'd summon reinforcements, including the tank. They then used the tank to destroy the generator, cutting power throughout Iziz, allowing the rebels to take out the droid under cover of darkness while winning the people's support. The rebels then decided on a leader, which they chose to be Steela, Saw walked out of their hideout in resentment.<ref name=":2" />
[[File:Saw_and_Dendup_are_caught.jpg|left|thumb|250x250px|Gerrera's failed attempt to liberate [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]].]]
Some time later, Steela addressed all of Iziz, denouncing the usurper king, [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]], as a Separatist puppet. But as rain came down, [[Dono]] came by to alert the rebels that the Separatists are planning [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup's]] execution, accusing him of being behind their attacks. Steela decided that they would rescue him at the execution, despite Saw's insistence that it's an obvious trap. Frustrated, Saw set off for the palace and used an [[Ascension gun/Legends|ascension cable]] to infiltrate the true king's prison. There, he convinces Dendup to retake his throne, but accidentally triggers a one-way shield, sounding the alarm and resulting in Saw's capture. He is then tortured by the [[Super tactical droid/Legends|super tactical droid]] [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]] for the whereabouts of his comrades. General [[Tandin/Legends|Tandin]] stopped their barbaric torture, fearing it would kill Saw. Taking the young man to another interrogation room, Tandin questions Saw's motivations. In turn, Saw stated that he was a patriot, fighting for Onderon's freedom whereas men like Tandin allowed the Separatists to gain control.<ref name="The Soft War" />

The next day, Saw was brought to bear witness to Dendup`s execution. As expected, the rebels rose out of the crowd to free both men, and as he feared, it was a trap, as droids emerged from the crowd, cutting off their escape. But before Rash could recommence the execution, Tandin and the Onderon militia arrive to save them, having been convinced by Saw's arguments and helped them escape. Back at their hideout, Saw agreed to work alongside his fellow freedom fighters.<ref name="The Soft War" />

The rebels soon moved out of Iziz into the mountains. Though Saw believed they should take the fight directly to Rash, Lux argued that they want to avoid civilians causalities and they'd be depleting the droids' numbers. Unfortunately, Kalani dispatched [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|droid gunships]] to annihilate the rebels. Despite the rebels' use of mountain terrain, the gunships were protected by [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]]. Even worse, the Jedi refused to directly intervene in the conflict. However, Skywalker sent [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] to deliver rocket launchers to destroy the gunships, thus evening the odds. As Saw shot down the last gunship, it crashed near the rebel encampment and nearly sent both Steela and Lux falling off the edge of a cliff. Though Tano managed to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to levitate Lux to safety, the still active gunship shot her in the arm before she could save Steela, sending her falling to her death. Saw cradled his sister's body, blaming himself for indirectly causing her death. Lux assured him he's not to blame, stating that Steela knew the risks.<ref name="Tipping Points" />

Despite the loss of his sister, their victory won them the war. The Separatists decided to cut their losses and withdraw, as well as killing Rash. As a funeral is held for Steela in Iziz, Tano apologized to Saw for failing to save her. Saw accepted her apology but reminded her that the war is over now.<ref name="Tipping Points" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He fashions himself as our leader, though no one elected him.|Steela Gerrera|<ref name="WoTF" />}}
Gerrera named himself the leader of the rebellion when there wasn't one.<ref name="WoTF" /> Saw's fiery determination often made him short-tempered, much to the chagrin of fellow rebels Steela and Lux.<ref name=":1" /> He was blunt, direct, and armed with a fiery temper that maked him a natural leader in the loose command structure of the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]].<ref name=":0" />

Gerrera was a talented soldier<ref name="WoTF" /> and a fierce fighter. He has a natural born initiative and instinct for command, which causes him to take point in any situation.<ref name=":5" /> He was able to help fight an entire group of droids<ref name="WoTF" /> and disarm an AAT with help from Lux Bonteri.<ref name=":2" /> He was also a skilled beast-rider, who flew a [[Ruping/Legends|ruping]] into the thick of battle.<ref>{{SWE|1=characters|2=ruping|3=ruping}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Saw Gerrera was voiced by [[Andrew Kishino]]. He was originally conceived by [[George Lucas]] for the unproduced ''[[Star Wars: Underworld]]''.<ref name="SW-10 Things You Should Know About Saw Gerrera from ''The Clone Wars''">{{SW|url=news/10-things-you-should-know-about-saw-gerrera-from-the-clone-wars|text=10 Things You Should Know About Saw Gerrera from ''The Clone Wars''}}</ref>

Saw's name was derived from the [[Wikipedia:Communist revolution|Marxist revolutionary]] [[Wikipedia:Che Guevara|Che Guevara]], an icon of the [[1950s]] [[Wikipedia:Cuban Revolution|Cuban Revolution]].<ref name="The Art of Rogue One">''[[The Art of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>
